title: BodyForge character proportions
description: Format of the <char>.vhforges.json file applied at runtime by the BodyForge BepInEx plugin. Schema 1 contains bone scales; schema 2 also supports neutral-based anatomical sliders.

schemaVersion.description: Schema 1 remains readable. Schema 2 adds the optional anatomy object.

character.description: Character base name (e.g. 'lst'). Informational only; the plugin associates the file by the .fch base name itself.

enabled.description: false ignores the bone (keeps the original localScale).

bones.description: Map of bone name -> local transform (final scale applied to Transform.localScale). Bones not listed are left untouched.

anatomy.description: Semantic anatomical slider values. Zero is always the exact vanilla body. The active model profile maps values to its own anatomy; equipment uses the resulting shared deformation field.

showBoneControls.description: Whether the editor displays the optional advanced bone controls. This does not affect the applied bone values.

editorState.description: Optional editor-only presentation state ignored by the runtime plugin.
